description:
QSIG geopolitical theme board. For each theme (HORMUZ_OIL, IRAN, LEVANT,
    RUSSIA_UKRAINE, CHINA_TAIWAN, FED, CRYPTO): the Polymarket crowd stress
    index and its 24h / 7d change on the same markets, tracked whale positions
    and 24h flows (aggregates only, no wallet addresses), the news-event count
    against its same-window baseline, and the top 3 markets.

    theme is an optional key; omit it for all themes. as_of is an optional
    ISO 8601 UTC timestamp such as "2026-10-05T12:00:00Z"; the latest hourly
    snapshot at or before it is returned. History begins 2026-09-29.

    Themes with coverage.sufficient = false are returned but should not be
    read as meaningful. stress_index is a direction and change gauge, not a
    probability: read change_24h and change_7d.

    This is a MEASURED STATE, not a forecast. Paid route: $0.02 USDC via x402.
    Call list_geo_themes first (free) to see keys and coverage before paying.
name: get_geo_themes
